نتخاصم (form VI)
# نَتَخَاصَمُ (nataḵāṣamu) /na.ta.xaː.sˤa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# نَتَخَاصَمَ (nataḵāṣama) /na.ta.xaː.sˤa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# نَتَخَاصَمْ (nataḵāṣam) /na.ta.xaː.sˤam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
